---
title: "01 - Scrape ride wait times (Queue Times)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(janitor)

dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Check robots.txt, then download the page

(No `polite` package needed: we read robots.txt ourselves and pause between requests.)

```{r fetch}
park_id <- 8   # 8 = Animal Kingdom
url     <- paste0("https://queue-times.com/parks/", park_id, "/stats")

# Read robots.txt and look for rules that would block /parks/
readLines("https://queue-times.com/robots.txt", warn = FALSE)

polite_read <- function(u, delay = 5) {
  Sys.sleep(delay)          # be kind to the server: one request every few seconds
  read_html(u)
}

page <- polite_read(url)
```

## 2. Inspect: what tables are on the page?

The ride tables are plain HTML, so `html_table()` works (no browser automation needed).
The "Loading..." chart sections are JavaScript and are not needed.

```{r inspect}
all_tables <- page |> html_elements("table") |> html_table()
length(all_tables)
map(all_tables, names)   # find the tables whose headers mention "queue time"
```

## 3. Pull the two ride-level tables and tidy them

Tables are found by header text rather than position, so the code survives if the page order changes.

```{r tidy}
park_name <- page |> html_element("h1") |> html_text2()

find_table <- function(tables, pattern) {
  hit <- keep(tables, ~ any(str_detect(names(.x), regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))))
  stopifnot("No table matched that header" = length(hit) >= 1)
  hit[[1]]
}

avg_wait <- find_table(all_tables, "overall average") |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(ride = 1, avg_wait_mins = 2)

max_wait <- find_table(all_tables, "maximum") |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(ride = 1, avg_max_wait_mins = 2)

rides_wait <- avg_wait |>
  full_join(max_wait, by = "ride") |>
  mutate(
    ride          = str_squish(ride),
    avg_wait_mins = parse_number(as.character(avg_wait_mins)),
    avg_max_wait_mins = parse_number(as.character(avg_max_wait_mins)),
    park_id       = park_id,
    park_name     = park_name,
    scraped_at    = Sys.time()
  )

rides_wait
```

## 4. (Optional) Park-level crowd tables

```{r crowd}
crowd_by_month <- find_table(all_tables, "by month|^month") |> clean_names()
```
If that errors, run `map(all_tables, names)` and match the exact header text.

## 5. (Optional) Discover year / event filter URLs

The year and event filters are links. List them instead of guessing the URL format.

```{r links}
page |>
  html_elements("a") |>
  html_attr("href") |>
  str_subset("stats") |>
  unique()
```
Once you know the pattern, wrap steps 2-3 in a function and loop over parks and years,
using `polite_read(new_url)` so the delay between requests is respected.

## 6. Save the raw data

```{r save}
write_csv(rides_wait, paste0("data/raw/queue_times_park_", park_id, ".csv"))
```

## 7. Quick validation

```{r validate}
rides_wait |> filter(is.na(avg_wait_mins) | avg_wait_mins < 0 | avg_wait_mins > 300)
rides_wait |> count(ride) |> filter(n > 1)   # duplicates
stopifnot(nrow(rides_wait) > 0)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(janitor)

url  <- "https://queue-times.com/parks/6/stats"
page <- read_html(url)

all_tables <- page |> html_elements("table") |> html_table()

avg_wait <- all_tables |>
  keep(~ any(str_detect(names(.x), regex("overall average", ignore_case = TRUE)))) |>
  pluck(1) |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(ride = 1, avg_wait_mins = 2) |>
  mutate(ride = str_squish(ride),
         avg_wait_mins = parse_number(as.character(avg_wait_mins)))

avg_wait
```

```{r}
# STEP 1: Install packages (only needed once)
install.packages(c(
  "tidyverse",
  "rvest",
  "janitor",
  "jsonlite"
))

# STEP 2: Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(janitor)
library(jsonlite)

# STEP 3: Get every park from Queue Times
park_groups <- fromJSON(
  "https://queue-times.com/parks.json",
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

parks <- map_dfr(park_groups, function(group) {
  map_dfr(group$parks, function(park) {
    tibble(
      park_id = as.integer(park$id),
      park_name = park$name,
      country = park$country
    )
  })
})

# View the full park list
View(parks)

# STEP 4: Filter to US amusement parks only

parks <- parks |>
  filter(country == "United States")

# Choose which parks to scrape
# TRUE = test on 3 parks
# FALSE = scrape every US park

test_mode <- FALSE

if (test_mode) {
  parks_to_scrape <- parks |>
    filter(park_name %in% c(
      "Cedar Point",
      "Kings Island",
      "Hersheypark"
    ))
} else {
  parks_to_scrape <- parks
}

# STEP 5: Create empty storage tables
all_wait_times <- tibble(
  park_id = integer(),
  park_name = character(),
  country = character(),
  ride = character(),
  avg_wait_mins = double()
)

failed_parks <- tibble(
  park_id = integer(),
  park_name = character(),
  reason = character()
)

# STEP 6: Loop through the parks
for (i in seq_len(nrow(parks_to_scrape))) {
  
  park_id <- parks_to_scrape$park_id[i]
  park_name <- parks_to_scrape$park_name[i]
  country <- parks_to_scrape$country[i]
  
  url <- paste0(
    "https://queue-times.com/parks/",
    park_id,
    "/stats"
  )
  
  cat("Scraping:", park_name, "\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    
    # YOUR ORIGINAL SCRAPING CODE
    page <- read_html(url)
    
    all_tables <- page |>
      html_elements("table") |>
      html_table()
    
    matching_tables <- all_tables |>
      keep(~ any(str_detect(
        names(.x),
        regex("overall average", ignore_case = TRUE)
      )))
    
    # Stop if the expected table is missing
    if (length(matching_tables) == 0) {
      stop("Average wait time table not found")
    }
    
    avg_wait <- matching_tables |>
      pluck(1) |>
      clean_names() |>
      select(1:2) |>
      rename(
        ride = 1,
        avg_wait_mins = 2
      ) |>
      mutate(
        ride = str_squish(ride),
        avg_wait_mins = parse_number(
          as.character(avg_wait_mins)
        ),
        park_id = park_id,
        park_name = park_name,
        country = country
      ) |>
      relocate(
        park_id,
        park_name,
        country
      )
    
    # Combine with previously scraped parks
    all_wait_times <- bind_rows(
      all_wait_times,
      avg_wait
    )
    
    cat("Success:", nrow(avg_wait), "rides\n")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    
    cat("FAILED:", park_name, "\n")
    
    failed_parks <- bind_rows(
      failed_parks,
      tibble(
        park_id = park_id,
        park_name = park_name,
        reason = conditionMessage(e)
      )
    )
    
  })
  
  # Wait 2 seconds before next request
  Sys.sleep(2)
}

# STEP 7: Check results
View(all_wait_times)

# Number of parks successfully scraped
n_distinct(all_wait_times$park_id)

# Total ride records
nrow(all_wait_times)

# Number of failed parks
nrow(failed_parks)

# STEP 8: Export results
write_csv(
  all_wait_times,
  "all_park_wait_times.csv"
)

write_csv(
  failed_parks,
  "failed_parks.csv"
)

write_csv(
  parks,
  "parks.csv"
)

# STEP 9: Find the saved files
getwd()

```
